answer: The invite tree caps each identity at three children per epoch, and a child's attestation carries full weight only when the parents sit on unrelated subnets. Two attestations from the same /24 mean the second pays a 60 percent tax into the pool, taken before the reward books. A farm on one host then pays that tax on nearly every vote while an honest tree keeps full weight. The trade-off is real: a studio on one terrace eats the same tax as the farm, and a marble lobby looks no different from a hollow shell to the rule. I accept it only because the tax lands in the pool.
